verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada offers a public federal corporation search that shows whether an annual return is due (docs-16), and it publishes processing times so founders know what to expect (supp-1). Email notices are sent when status-related changes are filed (docs-17), but that is push notification rather than lookup on public pages. There is no documented way to check the status of a pending incorporation application or case. Missing for 10: a documented public lookup for pending filing or application status, case tracking from public pages, and independent or hands-on confirmation of what the corporation search shows.
